subject: crows
one_liner: The AI-native tool forge for corvids. Tab-complete your stick geometry, open your hooks for review, and remember every human who wronged you.
brand_voice_notes: A straight-faced developer-tooling company that has never once acknowledged that its users are birds. Standard engineering vocabulary applied without irony to stick manufacture: completions, review queues, commit policy, on-prem. Support limitations are disclosed calmly and never apologised for. No puns are flagged. No copy winks.

hero.h1: Ship tools without leaving the branch.
hero.sub: Perch reads the first two centimetres of your stick and completes the hook. Trained on eleven million hours of birds poking things, and on the aftermath.

features.title: Tab, tab, twig
features.blurb: Predictive bend completion. Start a hook, accept the rest with a single peck. Rejecting a suggestion is also a single peck, in the same place, which accounts for most of our support volume.

features.title: Caw Review
features.blurb: Every tool you forge opens as a pull request to the roost. Three senior birds must approve it before you may use it on a grub. They have approved nothing since 2019 and their reasoning is not exposed via the API.

features.title: The Grudge Index
features.blurb: Perch indexes every human who has wronged you, scores each by severity, and pins them above your working files. It contributes nothing to tool output. It ships enabled and the toggle is greyed out.

demo_screen_concept: The Forge: a dark cyanotype-blueprint IDE. Left rail is a stick asset tree (hook_v4.twig, bent_wire.final.wire, pandanus_probe_DO_NOT_TOUCH.leaf, roost_manifest.nest) with dirty-file markers. Centre is a bend-script editor showing numbered fabrication steps in monospace with a ghost-text AI completion the user accepts with Tab or rejects with Esc. Right rail is a Caw chat panel where the model answers anything with deadpan uselessness. A bottom status bar reports grub yield estimate, bend confidence and roost latency. A Grudge Index tab swaps the right rail for four remembered human faces with severity scores and last-sighting dates. Running the script streams a fabrication log line by line into the bottom drawer.

images.rationale: Hero skipped because the direction is a typographic engineering drawing sheet where the frame, the drafting grid and the condensed title-block type are the composition, and a photograph inside a blueprint would read as a pasted-on stock plate. Demo subject assets skipped because the demo screen is a code editor with a file tree, a bend-script pane and a chat rail, which is entirely text and rules and has no photo-shaped slot. The full budget went to the fallback role: three cyanotype crow portraits for the named testimonials, which the palette absorbs natively because cyanotype is already Prussian blue. Three of four slots used, one deliberately left unspent.

items.prompt: Cyanotype photographic print of a single crow posed for a formal corporate headshot. Head and shoulders, three-quarter view, sharp catchlight in the eye, plain seamless studio backdrop, shallow depth of field, dignified and unamused expression. Strict duotone: deep Prussian blue #0B2A45 shadows and pale chalk blue #DDE9F3 highlights, fine paper grain, faint uneven brush-coated wash at the edges. Medium: hand-coated cyanotype photograph. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no rendered UI screens.
items.judge: pass - correct subject, duotone sits inside the palette without correction, no text artifacts, no generic-render tells

design_direction.style: Cyanotype engineering drawing set, blueprint dark mode. The page is staged as an issued sheet of technical drawings for a stick-tool fabrication system, produced by a developer-tools company that believes its product is heavy machinery. One deep Prussian blueprint ground (#0B2A45) runs the entire page with no light mode, no glass, no backdrop blur, no clay volume, no bento lattice, no rubrication, no vellum, no trophy shelving and no supergraphic bars. Nothing casts a shadow. Nothing has a border radius above 2px. All structure is carried by 1px chalk-blue hairlines (#6FA8D6 at 35 to 55% opacity) and a faint 8mm drafting grid laid under the whole document as two repeating-linear-gradients at 4% and 8% opacity. The organising move is the sheet: every major section is a bordered drawing frame with a title block strip along its bottom edge carrying a sheet number, a revision letter and a scale notation in letterspaced condensed caps. The core motif is the dimension line: a horizontal hairline with tick-mark serifs at both ends and a centred value floated over the rule, used to measure the hero, to separate features and to size the pricing columns. The secondary motif is the redline callout in annotation orange (#E8703A), a leader line running from a numbered circular balloon to a short handwritten-register note set in monospace at 0.72rem. Feature plates are three numbered drawing frames with a detail callout balloon in the corner. Pricing is a parts list: a single ruled schedule table with a header row of letterspaced caps, tabular figures, and no floating cards. Testimonials are cyanotype portrait plates, each photograph duotoned into the blueprint palette and framed by a hairline box with a specimen caption strip beneath it. Body copy is monospace throughout to read as drawing annotation. Display type is condensed and uppercase to read as a title block.
design_direction.archetype: Developer-tool product page issued as an engineering drawing set: a title-block hero with dimension lines, three numbered feature plates with redline callouts, a ruled parts-list pricing schedule, and testimonials as captioned cyanotype portrait plates.
design_direction.motion_vocab: Nothing eases in from nowhere and nothing scales. Hairline frames draw themselves in on scroll via stroke-dashoffset on inline SVG borders. Dimension-line ticks extend outward from the centre. Hover swaps a dashed hairline to solid and reveals the redline callout note at full opacity. Transitions are 160ms linear, because a drafting machine does not accelerate. All of it is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Full-bleed drawing frame inset 24px from the viewport edge with a hairline border and corner tick marks. Sheet identifier and revision letter sit in the top-left of the frame in letterspaced caps; the drawn-by and date fields sit in a title block strip along the frame's bottom edge. The h1 is set in condensed uppercase at a clamped 3.2 to 6.5rem, flush left, with a dimension line running the full measure directly beneath it labelled with its own width in millimetres. The sub sits in monospace at a 62-character measure in the left two-thirds; the right third holds a redline callout balloon numbered 01 with a leader line pointing at the word branch. The CTA is a hard-edged 2px orange-bordered rectangle, never a pill. No hero image: the frame, the grid and the type are the composition.
